trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of Friday’s low reasonably targets 6340.5-6342.5, mindful of the 6335.5 spot in between. Given the general weakness of sellers as of late, it seems reasonable to expect them to panic cover and drive price through 6342.5 for a retest of Friday’s high if there is a failure below 6323.25.

trades.name: LAAF of 6340.5
trades.quote: A look above and fail of 6340.5 is a fair short targeting 6323.25-6327, mindful of 6335.5 in between. I would have most covered by Friday’s low, holding a runner if it breaks with continuation.

trades.name: Lower high below 6323.25
